what: Every verdict rule version tried in Week 6, in order. Append only; frozen at step 6.

versions.defined: step 3, before any copy was scored
rules: else two or more different weak finding codes -> suspicious
else PARSE_FAILED (the PDF could not be parsed) -> suspicious
notes: info findings are listed and never counted
weak findings count by distinct code, not by instance
PARSE_FAILED stays a weak finding; the third rule is what makes it suspicious

dev_results.scored: dev copies (60 per type, detector findings cached) and genuine dev (300)
dev_results.tampered_or_suspicious: identical to tampered for every type (no copy was only suspicious)
dev_results.without_file_history: identical rates for every type; the one re-save false alarm disappears
notes: rerender_consistent: no strong finding on any copy, so the only possible signal is the anomaly score, and one weak sign alone is not enough under v1
inplace_edit_consistent miss: an edit on the last page of a multi-page statement saved incrementally; only INCREMENTAL_UPDATE fired (one weak sign)
resaved_genuine false alarm: a statement the anomaly check flags, re-saved incrementally (ANOMALY_SCORE + INCREMENTAL_UPDATE)

versions.defined: step 5, after the v1 dev results and before v2 was run on any copy
rules: v1, plus: an ANOMALY_SCORE finding on its own (with no strong finding) -> suspicious
notes: an anomaly score is a weak finding, so it can never produce 'tampered'
the dev false-alarm rate of the anomaly check is IN-SAMPLE: its threshold was set on the genuine dev statements, so 2% of them exceed it by construction

adoption_rule.written: before v2 was run; applied exactly as written; otherwise v1 is kept
adopt_v2_only_if_all_of: (a) rerender_consistent detection, counted as tampered or suspicious, on dev rises by at least 10 percentage points over v1
(b) an anomaly score alone can never produce 'tampered'
(c) the 'tampered' false-alarm rate on genuine dev and on resaved_genuine is unchanged from v1

dev_results.scored: same cached dev findings as v1 (60 per type), resaved_genuine (60), genuine dev (300); reports/week6_rule_comparison_dev.json
dev_results.tampered: identical to v1 for every type
notes: the (a) margin is 1.7 points, 7 copies of 60
the 6/300 suspicious on genuine dev is the anomaly threshold's 2% by construction, not an independent estimate
rerender_consistent is still mostly missed: 53/60 get no flag

versions.decision: v2 adopted: all three conditions held, applied as written
